'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[2022–2023 Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure|Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure]]
***[[Bombing of Odesa (2022–present)|Bombing of Odesa]]
****The [[Russian Armed Forces]] strike grain warehouses in [[Odesa]] with [[Kalibr (missile family)|Kalibr]] missiles, destroying 120 tons of crops and injuring two [[civilian]]s, according to [[Governor of Odesa Oblast|Governor]] Oleh Kiper. [https://edition.cnn.com/europe/live-news/russia-ukraine-war-news-07-21-23/h_04abd2251c74e48f41adc2c87542803b (CNN)]
***[[Bombing of Mykolaiv (2022-present)|Bombing of Mykolaiv]]
****The Russian Armed Forces strike a building in [[Mykolaiv]], killing two civilians. [https://www.yenisafak.com/en/news/at-least-four-killed-27-injured-in-russian-strikes-in-odesa-mykolaiv-says-ukraine-3667174 (''Yeni Şafak'')]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Battle of Khartoum (2023–2025)|Battle of Khartoum]] 
***Fifteen civilians and 19 army officers are killed in a [[drone attack]] in [[Khartoum]], [[Sudan]]. [https://globeecho.com/news/deaths-in-a-raid-near-khartoum-and-the-release-of-prisoners-from-the-army/ (Globe Echo)]
**[[Darfur campaign (2023–present)|Darfur campaign]]
***At least 20 civilians are killed and more than 45 others are injured by [[Rocket artillery|rocket attacks]] on residential areas in [[Nyala, Sudan|Nyala]], [[South Darfur]], and [[Shell (projectile)|shelling]] in proximity to [[Health in Sudan|hospitals]] in [[El-Obeid]], [[North Kordofan]], as per reports from medical professionals and lawyers. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/2342766/amp (AFP via ''Arab News'')]
*[[Yemeni civil war (2014–present)|Yemeni civil war]]
**A [[World Food Programme]] employee is killed by unknown assailants in [[Taiz Governorate|Taiz]], [[Yemen]], with [[Republic of Yemen Armed Forces|security forces]] launching a pursuit of the individuals responsible. [https://mb.com.ph/2023/7/22/un-food-agency-worker-killed-in-south-yemen (AFP via ''Manila Bulletin'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*A [[wet market]] in [[Tomohon]], [[North Sulawesi]], [[Indonesia]], becomes the country's first market to cease the [[Cat meat|cat]] and [[dog meat]] trade following prolonged campaigning by local activists and global figures, supported by the [[Humane Society International]]. [https://www.latimes.com/world-nation/story/2023-07-21/indonesian-animal-market-has-ended-its-brutal-dog-and-cat-meat-trade-campaigners-say (AP via ''Los Angeles Times'')]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[Gambia cough syrup scandal]]
**The [[Politics of the Gambia|Gambian government]] identifies imported [[Pharmaceutical industry in India|Indian]] [[cough syrup]]s as the cause of at least 70 child deaths to [[kidney failure]], leading to regulatory changes and potential legal action against the [[Pharmaceutical manufacturing|manufacturer]], Maiden Pharmaceuticals. The [[World Health Organization]] confirms [[Ethylene glycol poisoning|lethal]] [[antifreeze]] substances in the [[Toxic cough syrup|syrups]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2023/07/22/Gambia-finds-Indian-cough-syrups-killed-70-infants (AFP via Al Arabiya)]
*[[Nigeria]]'s northwestern [[Kaduna State]] reports an outbreak of [[diphtheria]], which has killed 10 children since early July. [https://english.news.cn/20230721/0f773c5cc5194d6e8fb6eafc41dddbe0/c.html (Xinhua)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Opposition to Vladimir Putin in Russia]]
**[[Police of Russia|Police]] detain former [[Federal Security Service|intelligence]] officer, [[Russian people's militias in Ukraine|separatist]] commander and [[Angry Patriots Club]] leader [[Igor Girkin]] for alleged [[extremism]]. [https://guardian.ng/news/world/europe/russia-detains-former-separatist-commander-girkin/ (AFP via ''The Guardian'')]
*One person is killed and three others are injured in a [[mass stabbing]] near a [[Seoul Metropolitan Subway|subway]] station in [[Seoul]], [[South Korea]]. The attacker is apprehended. [https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/1-killed-3-injured-in-a-stabbing-rampage-in-south-koreas-seoul-101689925583961.html (AFP via ''The Hindustan Times'')]

'''Sports'''
*[[2023 Leagues Cup]]
**In [[association football]], [[Lionel Messi]] makes his [[North America|North American]] debut for [[Major League Soccer]] club [[Inter Miami CF]] in the [[Leagues Cup]] [[2023 Leagues Cup group stage|group stage]] match against [[Liga MX]] club [[Cruz Azul]]. During the final minutes of the game, he scored a goal to help Miami win the game. [https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/38049022/lionel-messi-named-substitute-first-inter-miami-game?platform=amp (ESPN)] [https://thespun.com/.amp/more/soccer/lionel-messi-scored-game-winning-goal-in-mls-debut (''The Spun'')]
*[[2023 Diamond League]]
**In [[Sport of athletics|athletics]], [[Faith Kipyegon]] of [[Kenya]] sets a new women's [[Mile run|mile]] [[Mile run world record progression|record]], finishing the [[Herculis]] at [[Stade Louis-II]] in [[Fontvieille, Monaco|Fontvieille]], [[Monaco]], in 4:07.64 and surpassing the previous 2019 record held by [[Sifan Hassan]] of the [[Netherlands]].
